summary: Based on due diligence demonstrating the potential for appropriate risk-adjusted return and strong alignment with TAF’s mandate, the Investment Committee is recommending four investments. The proposed investments are in compliance with the asset allocation range for Private (Pooled) Funds (maximum 5 percent) and Direct Investments (maximum 60 percent).
decided: The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved an investment of up to $1,000,000 alongside active co-investors in a Private (Pooled) real estate Fund as set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (October 25, 2019) from the Vice President, Impact Investing, with advances over time subject to the Fund meeting the Conditions Precedent recommended by the Investment Committee. 2. Approved a Direct Investment of up to $1,000,000 in a carbon utilization project as set out in Confidential Attachment 2 to the report (October 25, 2019) from the Vice President, Impact Investing. 3. Approved a Direct Investment of up to $2,000,000 in a renewable energy project, conditional on the Investment Committee’s satisfaction with the final term sheet and financial model (including the split returns to the developer and investors) and the capital structure, as set out in Confidential Attachment 3 to the report (October 25, 2019) from the Vice President, Impact Investing. 4. Approved a Direct Investment of up to $2,000,000 in take out financing for an institutional thermal heat recovery and supply system as set out in Confidential Attachment 4 to the report (October 25, 2019) from the Vice President, Impact Investing, conditional on the Investment Committee’s satisfaction with the final term sheet (including the priority and allotment of return between the investors and…
